sourceTitle: Orange & Pomelo Martini For Your New Year’s Party
sourceText:
Orange & Pomelo Martini For Your New Year’s Party
By: ravikumar
Published: Saturday, January 6, 2018 - 1:42am

Ingredients




Ice
Orange
Pomelo
Vodka
Pomegranate Juice
Lime Juice
Fresh Lime
Sugar Syrup

Preparation

1 1. Start by adding ice to a martini glass. 2 2. In another glass, add in orange slices, pomelo and muddle it. 3 3. To this add in some ice and vodka along with pomegranate juice, lime juice and sugar syrup. 4 4. Shake it well, strain and pour in the martini glass.

About

Orange and Pomelo Martini make a fantastic cocktail. Make this amazing Orange & Pomelo Martini and amaze all your party guests. Orange & Pomelo cocktail recipes are very easy and simple to make in just a few minutes.
